visual_table_reconciliation.visual_review_note: All 15 numbered main-text figures and 33 numbered main-text tables were inventoried. Key decision-path figures for HF staging, EF classification, diagnostic classification, HFrEF treatment, CRT, HFmrEF, HFpEF, transthyretin amyloidosis, comorbidity management, and disease trajectory were rendered and visually checked. The online supplement is organized primarily as section-level evidence tables; 99 Data Supplement table blocks were inventoried.

references.note: The main guideline reference section is extracted separately in source order. Supplement table-local citations were used for evidence reconciliation but not duplicated as a second bibliography.

key_quantitative_evidence.source: Main guideline e303; Online Data Supplement Section 7.3.1
key_quantitative_evidence.finding: PARADIGM-HF: sacubitril/valsartan reduced the composite of cardiovascular death or HF hospitalization by 20% relative to enalapril.

key_quantitative_evidence.source: Main guideline e307; Online Data Supplement Section 7.3.4
key_quantitative_evidence.finding: DAPA-HF and EMPEROR-Reduced: SGLT2 inhibitors reduced cardiovascular death or HF hospitalization by about 25%, with about a 30% reduction in HF hospitalization. Dapagliflozin reduced cardiovascular death by 18% and all-cause mortality by 17% in the source summary.

key_quantitative_evidence.source: Main guideline e326; Online Data Supplement Sections 7.6.1 and 7.7.1
key_quantitative_evidence.finding: EMPEROR-Preserved: 21% reduction in the primary composite of HF hospitalization or cardiovascular death, driven mostly by a 29% reduction in time to HF hospitalization; no all-cause mortality benefit was reported.

key_quantitative_evidence.source: Main guideline e332; Online Data Supplement Section 7.8.2
key_quantitative_evidence.finding: ATTR-ACT: all-cause mortality was 29.5% with tafamidis versus 42.9% with placebo, and cardiovascular-related hospitalization was 0.48 versus 0.70 per year after 30 months.

key_quantitative_evidence.source: Main guideline e353; Online Data Supplement Section 10.1
key_quantitative_evidence.finding: AFFIRM-AHF, 1,132 patients with EF below 50%: intravenous ferric carboxymaltose reduced HF hospitalization versus placebo, RR 0.74, 95% CI 0.58-0.94, without a reduction in cardiovascular death.

key_quantitative_evidence.topic: ICD after MI with low LVEF
key_quantitative_evidence.finding: MADIT-II is summarized as showing a 31% relative reduction in all-cause mortality with prophylactic ICD therapy in patients after MI with LVEF at or below 30%.

key_quantitative_evidence.source: Main guideline e329; Online Data Supplement Section 7.7.1
key_quantitative_evidence.finding: CHARM-Preserved: candesartan did not significantly reduce cardiovascular death or HF hospitalization, HR 0.89, 95% CI 0.77-1.03.

omissions_and_reasons: Underlying trial results summarized by the guideline were not converted to primary-study LiteratureAtoms; primary-study atoms require direct extraction of those publications.
The comprehensive RWI appendix was summarized at governance level rather than atomized person by person because individual disclosures are not clinical recommendations.
